text: Of all things, banish the egotism out of your conversation, and never think of entertaining people with your own personal concerns, or private, affairs; though they are interesting to you, they are tedious and impertinent to everybody else; besides that, one cannot keep one's own private affairs too secret.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter XVII, to his son, London, October 16, Old Style 1747
